modules.module_title: Prepare for Additive Manufacturing Process Setup

pcs.pc_description: Identify job requirements, part geometry, and customer specifications from design/CAD files.
Select the appropriate additive manufacturing process based on material, resolution, and functional needs.
Verify availability and calibration of required tools, equipment, and consumables.
Check environmental and safety conditions of the work area, ensuring compliance with organizational standards.
Inspect and verify the quality, type, and batch of material (filament, resin, or metal powder) as per job order.
Prepare and condition materials (drying, filtering, sieving, or degassing) to meet process requirements.
Load the material correctly into the machine as per manufacturer’s guidelines, ensuring contamination-free handling.

modules.module_title: Configure Process Parameters and Build Setup

pcs.pc_description: Generate slicing files using suitable software and define layer thickness, orientation, and support structure.
Optimize slicing and build parameters to reduce build time, improve surface finish, and minimize material waste.
erify alignment, calibration, and machine readiness before initiating the build.

modules.module_title: Execute and Monitor Additive Manufacturing Process

pcs.pc_description: Start the build process following approved work instructions and monitor initial layers for adhesion quality.
Monitor process parameters (temperature, laser power, feed rate, gas flow, etc.) during the build cycle.
Identify process deviations or abnormalities and perform corrective actions within authorized limits.
Record real-time process data and maintain build logs for traceability.
Perform necessary post-processing operations such as depowdering, support removal, heat treatment, machining, or surface finishing.
Inspect the final part for dimensional accuracy, surface quality, and defects as per quality standards.
Segregate non-conforming parts and report defects to relevant authorities for corrective action.
Analyze build data and inspection results to identify opportunities for process improvement.
Implement optimization measures such as revised parameters, build orientation changes, or material usage improvements.
Document all process parameters, changes, and improvements for future reference and standardization.
